verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a SaaS scraping API that processes customer requests and offers AI features such as ai_query and GPT/Gemini endpoints. A training-data opt-out or no-training policy is therefore a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy or retention control, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
